intro: Beginner setup: turn on safe observation, select your platforms, add any words or domains you always want flagged, save, and test. Observation never moderates anyone. Automatic actions remain a separate optional step.

sections.title: 1. Safe beginner setup
sections.description: Watch for problems without taking action against anyone.
sections.notice: Matched messages are hidden from the local StreamBridge browser chat before presentation. Provider warnings, deletes, timeouts, and bans remain off until separately approved.

sections.title: 2. Common spam checks
sections.description: Simple on/off switches; beginner-friendly limits are already supplied.
sections.notice: You do not need to change the number limits for your first test. Open Advanced tuning later only if normal chat is being flagged too often or not often enough.

sections.title: 3. People Chat Guard should leave alone
sections.description: Broadcaster and moderators are exempt by default.
sections.notice: For one specific viewer, use the Trusted viewers manager below. Reply to their message with !guardtrust after importing and enabling that command. You do not need to find or type their user ID.

sections.title: 4. Optional automatic action
sections.description: Skip this section if you only want reports and rule testing.
sections.notice: Recommended live policy: Warn first, then suppress the third matched offender for ten minutes on every THSV overlay. Twitch, YouTube, and Kick also receive native timeouts; TikTok uses the local timeout because TikFinity exposes no native moderation action. Both approval switches must be on before Chat Guard can act.

sections.title: 5. Advanced rule tuning
sections.description: Optional thresholds for deciding when a message should be flagged.
sections.notice: Most users should keep these defaults. Allowed domains is an allowlist: when it contains anything, links outside the list are flagged. Legacy ignored accounts require platform|stable-user-id; prefer !guardtrust instead.

sections.title: 6. Advanced automatic-action limits
sections.description: Optional platform, rule, timeout, warning, and rate-limit controls.
sections.notice: These controls matter only when automatic actions are enabled. Keep the safe defaults and Warn mode until genuine live testing succeeds.

sections.title: 7. Data limits
sections.notice: Defaults retain only bounded hashes and rule IDs for troubleshooting. Chat text and ordinary viewer identities are not stored. Deliberately trusted viewers retain only the stable ID needed for that exception.
